howTo: The leagues object starts empty because this repo has no settled-results archive to measure dangerous prices from. Add a league, or drop a replacement file at ENGINE_DATA_DIR/league-risk.json (or LEAGUE_RISK_PATH) which replaces this table on the next engine cycle. A key is the tournament name, or "country | tournament", matched without case. Each band is {"market":"over25","min":1.40,"max":1.49,"action":"exclude"}. action exclude drops the pick. action penalise keeps it but caps the grade at 90% so it is not 100%. market "*" means every market. min and max are inclusive and use the same prices as the odds-range table. Market ids are the engine ids: home, away, draw, over15, over25, over35, under15, under25, under35, btts, btts-no, dc-1x, dc-12, dc-x2, dnb-home, dnb-away, home-score, away-score, fh-over05, fh-over15, sh-over05, and the other ids in server/occurrence.mjs.
